title: Site Settings
subtitle: Configure the web portal site info, footer copyright/filings and Baidu Analytics. For the admin (ERP) system's own site info, go to System Config → Site Settings

placeholder.site_url: Leave empty to use the current domain
placeholder.site_logo: Click the image to upload a logo; PNG / JPG / SVG up to 2MB; shows the default icon when empty, transparent PNG around 36px tall recommended
placeholder.contact_email_help: Shown on the front-end "Become a Sponsor" page for sponsorship/partnership contact; left empty means not shown
placeholder.site_copyright: Empty shows: © Year Site Name · All rights reserved; {year} and {site} placeholders supported
placeholder.tongji_help: In Baidu Analytics, go to Manage → Code, and copy the 32-char key after hm.js?. Once filled and enabled, the tracking script is injected automatically; the switch has no effect when the key is empty
